biography:
I recently completed a Master of Finance at the University of Cambridge, building on a foundation in financial analysis developed during my time at PwC and further deepened through hands-on equity research experience at Squarepoint Capital.

At Squarepoint, I conducted bottom-up research across consumer, luxury, and industrial sectors — pitching investment ideas, building DCF models with sensitivity analysis, and using both fundamental and alternative data to identify drivers of company performance.

Alongside my studies, I was elected Portfolio Manager of the Cambridge University Student Investment Fund, where I led eight sector teams and oversaw portfolio construction and asset allocation. I collaborated closely with analysts to refine investment theses, assess valuation risk/reward, and apply institutional-quality investment discipline. My experience there — coupled with winning the London Business School Stock Pitch Competition — reflects a deep passion for public markets and an investment approach rooted in fundamental analysis and capital allocation quality.

Most recently, I worked as a Business Analyst at Knight Advisory Services, where I was seconded to a South African digital gaming start-up. I led financial competitor benchmarking, developed monthly cash flow forecasts, and identified performance-based marketing strategies that directly increased revenue.

I began my career in the assurance division at PwC, working primarily with financial technology and payments clients, where I built a strong understanding of financial reporting, controls, and the integrity of valuation assumptions.

Outside of work, I actively manage a personal long only portfolio focused on companies with sustainable growth, strong margins, disciplined capital allocation, and meaningful insider ownership.
